high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "richertoday." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the "5/9" at the top right corner, suggesting it is the fifth out of nine parts. Header: The post is titled "High Value Customers." It mentions that Airtel increased the price of its cheapest plan from Rs. 23 to Rs. 49 in December 2019. The post states that despite losing 4.8 Cr users, Airtel saved costs and increased profits
